capability.summary: Language models are compared on question-answering benchmarks that pose each question in one wording, and a reworded question can change which of two models scores higher. capability.title: Prompt Sensitivity in Tool-Augmented Model Comparisons

agency.summary: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains.
agency.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence

agency.summary: Offline tests can fail to reveal whether an agent update will remain safe after deployment. agency.title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
